title: The Passage of Doom
hook: Your Darklake voyage takes you into a narrow, thirty-foot wide, Faerzeress lit tunnel of eerie quiet
threats: Some bizarre, violent beam of light from behind a stalactite above the islet just put a hole in your keel boat! You're taking on water, fast, but you don't have time to think. A ten foot diameter floating sphere has emerged from behind the large stalactite and is floating your way.
